steps.description:
A bulletin belongs to one Function, and picking it does most of the work: the section switches come from Bulletin Settings, the Order of Worship is the function's own schedule, this week's missionary is chosen, and the open prayer requests are pulled in.

Pick a Function to continue.
steps.label: The Function
steps.title: The Function

steps.description: A Bible Reference printed on the cover. The church's own key verse is separate, and prints inside when Church Verse is switched on below.
steps.label: Verse of the Week
steps.title: Verse of the Week

steps.description: Copied from Bulletin Settings when you picked the Function. Untick one to drop that section from this bulletin only. The Sermon Handout Insert, for instance, is the handout of any Sermon on the function's schedule.
steps.label: Sections
steps.title: Sections

steps.description: Edit the list freely once it is filled. Adding a request marked private refuses to save: private requests are never printed.
steps.label: Prayer Requests
steps.title: Prayer Requests

steps.description: This only controls the portal. An unpublished bulletin still prints and still produces a PDF; members just cannot download it themselves.
steps.label: Show in Portal
steps.title: Show in Portal
